title: Shared: SFN derivation spec
description:
Document the SFN (Superframe Number) derivation algorithm in the spec.

## File
spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md

## Required Content

### SFN Derivation Formula
```
sfn = (unix_time_ms - EPOCH_BASE_MS) // SUPERFRAME_DURATION_MS
```

### Constants to Define
- **EPOCH_BASE**: 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (unix timestamp: 1704067200000 ms)
- **SUPERFRAME_DURATION_MS**: 100ms (default, configurable)

### Channel Selection
```
channel = 1 + (lichen_hash_32(seed || sfn) % n_channels)
```

### Fallback Chain
1. GNSS-synchronized (when GNSS fix available)
2. Epoch-based hash (existing implementation)
3. Channel 0 (density > 8 or error)
